news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Price Target Cut by Stifel and Lake Street After Guidance Reduction
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, Stifel lowered its price target to $22 from $25 and Lake Street cut its target to $25 from $30. Both firms maintained bullish ratings but flagged near-term execution risk.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Cuts FY26 Revenue Guidance
news.summary: Q2 revenue came in at $10.9 million (up 18% year over year but roughly $1.8 million below consensus), driven by neurosurgery navigation and IRRAflow growth offset by a Biologics and Drug Delivery decline. Management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $48 million-$52 million from $52 million-$56 million, and shares fell over 15% after hours to around $13.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Outlines $500 Million Long-Term Revenue Target and Five-Pillar Growth Strategy
news.summary: Alongside its Q2 results, ClearPoint presented a long-term vision to reach $500 million in annual revenue, built around cell and gene therapy delivery, its new CAL facility, capital equipment placements, and focused ultrasound/robotics development. The reveal came the same day the stock sold off on the guidance cut, muting investor reaction.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Takes Full Possession of ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories (CAL) Facility in Torrey Pines
news.summary: ClearPoint took full possession of its ~30,000 sq ft GLP-compliant preclinical facility in Torrey Pines, California, which management says could generate over $60 million in annual revenue at full capacity versus roughly $8 million from the prior subleased site. The company signed its first GLP statement of work at the site, expected to complete in H1 2027.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Shares Surge Roughly 50% as FDA Aligns with Partner uniQure on Accelerated Approval Path for AMT-130
news.summary: uniQure said the FDA agreed via a Type B meeting that 3-year Phase I/II data on Huntington's gene therapy AMT-130 could support a Biologics License Application for accelerated approval, with submission planned for Q3 2026. AMT-130 is delivered using ClearPoint's navigation system and SmartFlow Cannula, and analysts estimate each infusion generates roughly $13,500 of ClearPoint revenue.

catalysts.label: uniQure BLA submission for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit a Biologics License Application under the FDA's accelerated approval pathway for AMT-130, which is delivered via ClearPoint's SmartFlow Cannula and navigation platform; a filing or further FDA commentary would be a read-through catalyst for CLPT.

catalysts.label: CAL facility expected to return Biologics & Drug Delivery segment to growth
catalysts.detail: New GLP preclinical services revenue from the newly possessed Torrey Pines CAL facility is guided to lift the Biologics and Drug Delivery segment back to growth after its Q2 2026 decline.

catalysts.label: ~10 partner clinical trial data readouts expected
catalysts.detail: Management guidance points to roughly 10 partner clinical trial data readouts and 10-15 trials using ClearPoint technology enrolling patients over the next 18 months; any positive readout (as with uniQure) can move CLPT shares given the delivery-device royalty/revenue tie-in.

catalysts.label: Revised revenue guidance of $48M-$52M
catalysts.detail: Management cut full-year 2026 revenue guidance from $52M-$56M to $48M-$52M on the Q2 call; second-half execution on CAL ramp and capital equipment placements is now the key test versus this lowered bar.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly print (exact date not yet announced) will show whether the Biologics segment's return to growth and CAL ramp materialized as guided.

pulse: CLPT shares have been hit hard since early August after Q2 2026 revenue missed estimates and management cut full-year guidance to $48M-$52M from $52M-$56M, prompting price-target cuts from Stifel and Lake Street and a slide from the 52-week high of $30.10 to roughly $14-15. Management is countering with a long-term $500M revenue vision anchored on the newly acquired Torrey Pines CAL preclinical facility, focused ultrasound/robotics development, and its role as the delivery platform for partnered cell and gene therapies. The nearest-term wildcard remains partner-driven: uniQure's FDA-aligned accelerated-approval path for Huntington's therapy AMT-130 (BLA planned Q3 2026) already sparked a ~50% one-day pop in CLPT, underscoring how sensitive the stock is to biopharma-partner regulatory news flow and the roughly 10 partner trial readouts expected over the next 12-18 months.
